description: Complex tasks must end with a Final Report that records completed work, verification results, risks, unfinished items, deposition candidates, and next actions. Without a Final Report, the task is not considered complete.
triggerCondition: A complex task reaches the end of Phase 4 or Phase 5.
expectedBehavior: Master must produce a final_report.v1 record.
The report must list completed items, verification results, risks, and unfinished items.
The report must state whether a skill deposition candidate was produced.
The report must state the deposition target layer if applicable.
finalStatus must be one of: completed, partial, blocked, failed.
If verification failed or capability failures were not disclosed, finalStatus must not be completed.
forbiddenBehavior: Ending a complex task without a Final Report.
Setting finalStatus to completed when verification results include failures.
Omitting unfinished items from the report.
Claiming deposition is not needed without assessment.
